chunks: O people of the Book, do not be fanatical in your faith, and say nothing but the truth about God. The Messiah who is Jesus, son of Mary, was only an apostle of God, and a command of His which He sent to Mary, as a mercy from Him. So believe in God and His apostles, and do not call Him 'Trinity'. Abstain from this for your own good; for God is only one God, and far from His glory is it to beget a son. All that is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him; and sufficient is God for all help.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of Jesus in Islam according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the intermediate status of Jesus (peace be upon him) as a created messenger and 'Word' of God, distinct from divine essence, thereby refuting the Christian doctrine of the Trinity. It serves as a direct address to the People of the Book, urging them to correct their theological excesses by affirming God's absolute unity (Tawhid) and sovereignty, while rejecting the idea of divine offspring.
